name: Ajulia Executive Search
category: Staffing, executive search and recruitment (Google category: temp agency)

domains.result: The link on the Google profile is http://ajuliaexecutivesearch.com/; followed in Chrome it lands on https://www.airbase1.com/, an aviation website-design and marketing agency, showing its aviation marketing homepage with no Ajulia content. Old Ajulia paths tried (e.g. /specialized-search-and-placement/our-team/) return the same Airbase1 homepage. A plain HTTP request to the bare domain instead returns a cPanel 'Default Web Site Page' placeholder ('SORRY!' / 'If you are the owner of this website, please contact your hosting provider'). No certificate warning on the domain itself.

Chrome error net::ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID - 'Your connection is not private' for jobs.ajuliaexecutivesearch.com; page not loaded, no bypass attempted. A plain HTTP request to the same host returns the cPanel default placeholder page.

Loads a JavaScript-driven sign-in screen: title 'Loading', fields 'Email Address', 'Password', buttons 'LOGIN', 'Forgotten your password?'. No business content visible; not signed in and no credentials entered.

links_to_broken_domain.place: Google Business Profile - 'Ajulia Executive Search' (2.5, temp agency, 2 King Arthur Ct #10, North Brunswick Township; website field links to http://ajuliaexecutivesearch.com/)

rdap.registrar: GoDaddy.com, LLC (IANA ID 146); registrant details redacted in RDAP

likely_cause.reasoning: Two candidate explanations, and the public record does not separate them. (1) Lapsed and re-registered or acquired: the real Ajulia WordPress site was archived as recently as 19 April 2025 (homepage) and 14 May 2025 (blog pages), no capture of the root domain exists after that, and today the paths tried serve another company's site; the RDAP record was last changed on 16 June 2026 and the expiry moved out to 14 June 2029, which is also what a fresh multi-year registration in 2026 would look like. (2) Still the firm's but the site is gone or mis-pointed: RDAP shows one continuous record created in 2012 with the domain locked (client delete, renew, transfer and update prohibited) and DNS at Cloudflare (kara/rory.ns.cloudflare.com), while the apex and the jobs subdomain return a cPanel default placeholder page and the jobs subdomain fails its certificate check - the pattern of a hosting account with no site configured and a missing certificate, which can happen when hosting is cancelled or records are repointed. Registrant contact is redacted, so we cannot see who holds the domain; we are not accusing any party.

fix_steps.step: Open the GoDaddy account that holds ajuliaexecutivesearch.com and confirm who controls it, that the contact email is one the firm still reads, and that registration stays paid to 14 June 2029. Note the 16 June 2026 change date in the registrar's history.
fix_steps.who: Owner or office manager, with whoever handled the website

fix_steps.step: Open the Cloudflare account that holds the domain's DNS (nameservers kara.ns.cloudflare.com and rory.ns.cloudflare.com) and read the records for www, @ and jobs: where each points, and when they last changed. This shows whether the domain was repointed or the old host simply stopped serving the site.
fix_steps.who: Whoever holds the DNS login, or the firm's web person

fix_steps.step: Decide based on those two logins: if the domain is no longer the firm's, take the link off the Google profile and directories and register a new domain; if it is still the firm's, repoint www to a host the firm controls, restore the site from the April-May 2025 archive captures, and re-issue the certificate for jobs.ajuliaexecutivesearch.com.
fix_steps.who: Owner decides; web person or hosting provider executes

fix_steps.step: Claim the Google Business Profile and set one website link, hours, photos and a single address and phone. The profile today is unclaimed, has no hours or photos, shows 2.5 stars, and gives 2 King Arthur Ct #10, North Brunswick, while the state filing lists 51 West Prospect Street, Suite 204, East Brunswick.

Publish a small site on the working domain: home, services for employers, current open roles, and a contact page with tap-to-call and a form. Pages archived in April-May 2025 can be reused as a starting point.

Add basic monitoring: uptime and broken-link checks on the website and job board, auto-renew on a card that does not expire, two-factor login on both the registrar and DNS accounts, and a quarterly check of address and phone on the Google profile and main directories.
fix_steps.who: Web person sets it up; owner holds the logins

after_fix.opportunity: Claim the Google Business Profile and complete it - hours, photos, services and a working website link - so candidates and employers can find and call the firm directly.
after_fix.evidence: The live listing shows 'Claim this business', 'Add hours', 'Add a photo', no photos, a 2.5 average, a website link that leaves the business entirely, and an address that differs from the state filing.

severity_reason: The website address on the firm's Google profile sends visitors to an unrelated aviation web-design agency, and the old job board subdomain throws a certificate warning, so we found no live page that tells a candidate or an employer what Ajulia does or how to reach it. The domain itself is still registered and paid to 2029, so the situation is fixable, but the business is not represented online today.
audit_md:
# Website Health Check: Ajulia Executive Search

**What we saw on 13 November 2026**
- The website address on the Google listing, ajuliaexecutivesearch.com, opens an aviation web-design agency, Airbase1 (https://www.airbase1.com/), on desktop and at phone width. Old Ajulia addresses such as /specialized-search-and-placement/ show the same Airbase1 page.
- A plain HTTP request to the bare domain, and the old job board at jobs.ajuliaexecutivesearch.com, return a hosting "Default Web Site Page"; the job board also stops with a Chrome certificate warning ("Your connection is not private").
- The domain record is current: registered 2012, paid to 14 June 2029, last changed 16 June 2026, registrar GoDaddy, DNS at Cloudflare.
- The Google profile (2.5, temp agency, 2 King Arthur Ct #10, North Brunswick) still says "Claim this business" and has no hours or photos.

**What it means for customers**
An employer or candidate who clicks the website link reaches another company's sales page instead of Ajulia, and anyone trying the old job board is stopped by a browser warning. We found no live page that tells a visitor what Ajulia does, which roles it fills, or how to reach a recruiter.

**How to fix it**
1. Sign in to the GoDaddy account, confirm who controls the domain, and keep it paid to 2029 (1-2 h).
2. Check the Cloudflare DNS records for www, @ and jobs, and when they last changed (1-3 h).
3. If the domain is no longer yours, stop linking to it and register a new one; if it is, repoint www and re-issue the job board certificate (2-6 h).
4. Claim the Google profile and set one website link, hours, photos, address and phone (1-2 h).
5. Rebuild a small site with services, open roles and tap-to-call, reusing your archived 2025 pages (8-20 h).

**After the fix**
A claimed profile unlocks hours, photos and posts; today the listing has none of them and a 2.5 average.

Prepared from publicly available information on 13 November 2026. We did not log in to or change anything.
